scientific_integrity: Exact finite enumeration, algorithmic completeness proof and independently constructed second checker. No human or external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: A complete computation-assisted proof for the labeled binary projective three-space only; no general field-order result. Earlier triple labels and the 56 spreads are known. The full 1974 Bruen–Silverman and 1995 Jeurissen papers were inaccessible; equivalent earlier statements may exist. No independent scientific audit has occurred.
title: Regulus switching of spreads in \(\operatorname{PG}(3,2)\) gives the Kneser graph \(\operatorname{KG}(8,3)\)
